## mcrl alert close

Close alerts.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl alert close <alert-id>... --reason <text> [flags]

Close alerts. Pass "-" to read alert IDs from stdin, one per line.

The output is an array of the closed alerts.

API: POST /api/v0/alerts/<id>/close
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl alert close 2bj4Jd2KFaP --reason "fixed by restarting nginx"
  mcrl alert list --monitor 'disk usage' --jq '.[].id' | mcrl alert close - --reason "disk cleaned up"

Flags:
      --reason string   why the alerts are closed (required)
```

## mcrl alert get

Show an alert.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl alert get <alert-id> [flags]

Aliases:
  get, show

Show an alert.

--expand adds "_expanded": {"monitor": {...}, "host": {...}}.

API: GET /api/v0/alerts/<id>
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl alert get 2bj4Jd2KFaP
  mcrl alert get 2bj4Jd2KFaP --expand --jq '._expanded.monitor.name'

Flags:
      --expand   add monitor and host names under _expanded
```

## mcrl alert list

List alerts, newest first.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl alert list [flags]

Aliases:
  list, ls

List alerts, newest first. Only open alerts are listed unless --all.

Pages are fetched until --limit alerts are collected. --status, --type,
--monitor and --host filter on the client side, so they may read more pages.

--expand adds "_expanded": {"monitor": {...}, "host": {...}} to each alert.

API: GET /api/v0/alerts
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl alert list
  mcrl alert list --status CRITICAL --expand --jq '.[] | [.id, ._expanded.monitor.name, ._expanded.host.name] | @tsv'
  mcrl alert list --all --limit 0 -o jsonl > alerts.jsonl

Flags:
  -a, --all                  include closed alerts
      --expand               add monitor and host names under _expanded
      --host string          only alerts of this host (ID or name)
      --limit int            maximum number of alerts (0 = all) (default 100)
      --monitor string       only alerts of this monitor (ID or name)
      --status stringArray   only alerts in this status (repeatable): OK, WARNING, CRITICAL, UNKNOWN
      --type stringArray     only alerts of this monitor type (repeatable)
```

## mcrl alert logs

Show the status history of an alert.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl alert logs <alert-id> [flags]

Show the status history of an alert, newest first.

API: GET /api/v0/alerts/<id>/logs
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl alert logs 2bj4Jd2KFaP
  mcrl alert logs 2bj4Jd2KFaP --jq '.[] | [.status, .trigger, .createdAt] | @tsv'

Flags:
      --limit int   maximum number of log entries (0 = all) (default 100)
```

## mcrl alert memo

Set the memo of an alert.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl alert memo <alert-id> <text>

Set the memo of an alert. Pass "-" as the text to read it from stdin.

API: PUT /api/v0/alerts/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl alert memo 2bj4Jd2KFaP 'investigating: https://example.com/incident/123'
  journalctl -u app --since -10m | mcrl alert memo 2bj4Jd2KFaP -
```
